summary.text: Jason Morgan is the Democratic state representative for Michigan House District 23, which he has held since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia says he previously chaired the Washtenaw County Commission.

paragraphs.text: Jason Morgan earned a bachelor's degree from Northern Michigan University in 2011 and an M.P.A. from the University of Michigan in 2018, according to Ballotpedia.

His career experience includes working as an instructor with Washtenaw Community College, director of constituent services at the Michigan Department of State, and Michigan transition director for Congresswoman Elissa Slotkin.
He served as chair of the Washtenaw County Commission.
Morgan took office in the state House in 2023, succeeding Darrin Camilleri.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he named strengthening public schools, defending voting rights and investing in infrastructure, including roads, bridges, public transportation, water and broadband, as his key messages.
